entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I straightened myself on the sofa a..."
entries.dialogueText: I straightened myself on the sofa and looked at Karl. He was sitting on the couch across from me, ready to give me a report about an "incident". I had just learned that a policeman gunned down an entire crowd.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We stared at each other, not knowin..."
entries.dialogueText: We stared at each other, not knowing how to react. A muscle in his jaw twitched.

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: ""He was authorized to carry a sub-m..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was authorized to carry a sub-machine gun. And he used it..."

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: ""Sir. I know you wanted to stop the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sir. I know you wanted to stop the protests... But these people do not respect the police."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He lowered his head."
entries.dialogueText: He lowered his head.

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: ""Our men did their best to show res..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our men did their best to show restraint but six officers were beaten down by the protesters yesterday in Benfi."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Goddamit Karl!""
entries.dialogueText: "Goddamit Karl!"
entries.menuText: "Goddamit Karl!"

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: ""These are not innocent *citizens*..."
entries.dialogueText: "These are not innocent *citizens* anymore, Mr. President. They are a mob. And so one of our boys had a reaction under stress..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How many are we talking about, Kar..."
entries.dialogueText: "How many are we talking about, Karl?"
entries.menuText: "How many are we talking about, Karl?"

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: ""I won't defend his action, but wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't defend his action, but will not let him be thrown under the bus either. He was scared for his and his team's lives. Hundreds of rioters surrounded them, sir. There was a risk of lynching."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I told you to bring the situation..."
entries.dialogueText: "I told you to bring the situation under control, not shoot the entire crowd down!"
entries.menuText: "I told you to bring the situation under control, not shoot the entire crowd down!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How the hell did you let this happ..."
entries.dialogueText: "How the hell did you let this happen?"
entries.menuText: "How the hell did you let this happen?"

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""With the authorization you gave us..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the authorization you gave us, the Sordish Armed Forces have assumed direct control of the Bergia region for the purposes of eliminating the enemies of the state and bringing stability back to Sordland."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Mr. President. The BFF forces at S..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President. The BFF forces at Soll Dam have been eliminated. We have discovered and destroyed three hidden bases of operations."

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: ""Sir. The operation has been succes..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sir. The operation has been successful. The governor has been taken out of the dam unharmed and the armed rebels at the scene were eliminated."

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: ""Thanks to the new security laws, w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to the new security laws, we quickly cracked down on the Bergia region and caught about a hundred collaborators of the group."

entries.title: Narrator: "I straightened myself on the sofa a..."
entries.dialogueText: I straightened myself on the sofa and looked at Iosef, who was sitting on the couch across from me. He was here to give me a report about the military operations.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""The hunt for the militants continu..."
entries.dialogueText: "The hunt for the militants continues. Hundreds of armed rebels have already been eliminated and thousands of firearms captured."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "Great work, Iosef. When will it be over?"
